C10H14 with DBE=4. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 = 10 - 14/2 +1 = 10 -7 +1 =4. So 4 degrees of unsaturation. No aromatic, no carbonyl. So possibilities: 4 double bonds, or rings+double bonds combos. Cyclohexane ring is 1 DBE (ring). Alkene C=C adds 1 DBE. That's 2 DBE. Need 2 more DBE, maybe two more double bonds?
